newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Delfood to review European operations.
newsitem.headline: Delfood to review European operations.

text.p: South Africa's Del Monte Royal Foods Ltd said on Friday that it had decided to embark upon a strategic review of its European operations.
The firm said the scheme aimed at "optimising profitability with increased efficiencies, re-evaluating market strategy and improving operational and management structure."
"The strategic review should put us on a sound footing for strong medium term earnings growth," Delfood chairman Vivian Imerman said.
The company expected highly competitive conditions in Europe to continue to have a negative impact on prospects for earnings growth in 1997.
Overall, the group was budgeting to at least maintain earnings in the coming year.
